observations.description: Redis password 'OTn1WGEUUNsLJDQ3xfokPcxVe75YgtbMdvoPKLzW' hardcoded in 5 source files — exposed in git history permanently.
observations.recommendation: Mandatory REDIS_PASS env var with no default fallback; if missing, fail immediately. Remove all hardcoded password defaults. Rotate the exposed credential immediately. Migrate to secrets manager for production.

observations.description: Assertion 'relay.returncode is not None' is always True for any completed subprocess (even non-zero exit). Does not verify actual relay success.
